title: 孩子生病，怎么用英语跟学校请假？
summary: 美国学校要求孩子缺勤当天早上报备。这篇教你打电话请病假的说法，以及病好后返校的规定。

featuredPhrase.en: My child will be absent today.

phrases.en: My child will be absent today.
When can he come back to school?
Do I need a doctor's note?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Hi, this is Wei Chen's mom. He will be absent today.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是陈伟的妈妈。他今天请假。

dialogue.speaker: Attendance Office
dialogue.en: I'm sorry to hear that. What's wrong with him?
dialogue.zh: 听到这个很遗憾。他怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: He has a fever. It started last night.

dialogue.speaker: Attendance Office
dialogue.en: Okay, I've marked him absent. He can come back after he's been fever-free for 24 hours.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我记下了。他完全退烧 24 小时后可以返校。

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Got it. Do I need a doctor's note?
dialogue.zh: 明白了。需要医生证明吗？

dialogue.speaker: Attendance Office
dialogue.en: Only if he's out for more than three days.
dialogue.zh: 只有缺勤超过三天才需要。

seoTitle: 孩子生病请假英文怎么说？
seoDescription: 孩子生病怎么用英语跟美国学校请假？本文教你打电话报备缺勤的说法和返校规定，附完整对话。
